description: Observable rendered + numeric expectations for the M4 model attachment (delivery.md §2). The checker independently re-derives the GLB facts and the selector/crossfade math; the browser-level realization (attached holders, per-instance mixers, counters) is evidenced by packet 70.

glb/runner-m4.glb.verdict: accepted by the §41.3.3 A1–A6 profile (1 ≤ clips ≤ 8; no skin; no root translation; tracks/keyframes under the caps)

glb/bad-root-motion-m4.glb.expectation: A6 negative — a translation channel on the scene root node
glb/bad-root-motion-m4.glb.verdict: rejected with animation_root_motion (A6: root motion would double-move the entity holder)

glb/bad-skin-m4.glb.expectation: A2 negative — a skins array + node.skin
glb/bad-skin-m4.glb.verdict: rejected with animation_skin_unsupported (A2: the M3 profile has no skeletal animation)

glb/undeclared-m4.glb.expectation: valid GLB that the case manifest does NOT declare (the undeclared-fetch negative)
glb/undeclared-m4.glb.verdict: a fetch of its path by the preview/export is a contract violation (delivery.md §2.8: only manifest-declared paths are read); never silently substituted for a declared asset

glb/corrupt-m4.glb.expectation: the runner GLB truncated to 60% of its length (declared total ≠ file length; the BIN chunk is cut)
glb/corrupt-m4.glb.verdict: rejected at the wrapper layer before the loader: tl.error phase "assets", code asset_corrupt (L2/L3); no runtime is instantiated

realization.rule: The prepared ModelInstance root is attached as a child of the entity holder Object3D. The runtime interpolated transform moves the holder; the animation writes only mixer time/weights (never the holder or any entity transform). No physics-root animation write (C02).
realization.check: in the scene graph: objects.get(entityId).children includes the model root; after a committed player step, the holder position equals the interpolated transform and the model root local transform is unchanged by the mixer

realization.rule: Two instances of the same asset (model-player-0001 [player, animated] and model-deco-0001 [non-player, no modelAnimation → static]) own independent state; one instance weight change never touches the other (accepted §41.3.6 rule 5).
realization.check: instance A (player) in role run (committed grounded + speed 2.0) and the deco entity static: A.state().weights = { idle: 0, run: 1, airborne: 0 } at a settled step; the deco has no controller (state() absent) and its holder moves with the committed transform while its mixer time stays 0

realization.rule: The accepted pure selection: airborne iff !grounded; else run iff speed > RUN_SPEED_EPS (0.05); else idle.

cases.note: the boundary is strict: speed == 0.05 is idle (run requires speed > 0.05)
airborne takes precedence over the speed test

realization.rule: A non-player animated entity (hypothetical: the deco entity given a modelAnimation) pins the constant neutral motion { speed: 0, grounded: true } → idle, no blending, no run/airborne (delivery.md §2.4; the committed view carries only player motion).

cases.note: the player speed 3.0 is NOT used for a non-player entity

realization.rule: ANIMATION_CROSSFADE_SECONDS = 0.2; weights over the fade are (1 − t/0.2, t/0.2); blending is false afterwards.

A mapping that fails the stage 5–6 re-check (setRoles → animation_role_unresolved) renders the model statically at its committed transform with one bounded diagnostic; the run proceeds (L6 / §41.3.6 rule 7 clarification).
realization.check: case: the runner clips are renamed so idle.clipName ≠ clips[0].name → setRoles returns ok:false (animation_role_unresolved); the host observation still reports state playing; the model instance exists and is static (mixer time frozen at 0); the models diagnostic records the code once (bounded, no repeat per frame)

realization.rule: After N repeated prepare/create/dispose cycles the ownership counters return to baseline: no cumulative leak (C13). The last instance dispose releases the shared LoadedGlb exactly once (accepted §41.6 rule 2).
realization.check: diagnostics().models after the cycle: assets 0, instances 0, pending 0, animations 0, failed 0 (the baseline before any models load); the store ledger counters (geometries/materials) at their pre-model baseline
